description: Defines intrusive list data structures (forward and double linked lists) with associated iterators, supporting operations like push, pop, clear, and iteration. Implements intrusive lists using internal node pointers, with template parameters for node type and differentiation tags.

classes.name: intrusive_forward_list_element
classes.description: Base node class for intrusive forward list, contains pointer to next node.

classes.name: intrusive_forward_list
classes.description: Intrusive singly linked list supporting push_front, pop_front, iteration, and clear operations.

classes.name: intrusive_double_linked_list_element
classes.description: Base node class for intrusive double linked list, contains pointers to next and previous nodes.

classes.name: intrusive_double_linked_list
classes.description: Intrusive doubly linked list supporting push_front, push_back, pop, iteration, and clear operations.

methods.name: front
methods.description: Returns reference to the first element in the list.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Returns reference to the last element in the list (only for double linked list).

methods.name: push_front
methods.description: Inserts an element at the front of the list.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Inserts an element at the end of the list (only for double linked list).

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes a specific element from the list (only for double linked list).

methods.name: pop_front
methods.description: Removes the first element from the list.

methods.name: pop_back
methods.description: Removes the last element from the list (only for double linked list).

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all elements from the list.
